mapper.select: SELECT ora.id, ora.order_id, o.order_no, ora.refund_no, ora.apply_amount, ora.apply_reason, ora.status, CASE WHEN ora.status = 'APPLIED' THEN '待审核' WHEN ora.status = 'APPROVED' THEN '审核通过' WHEN ora.status = 'REJECTED' THEN '审核拒绝' WHEN ora.status = 'REFUNDED' THEN '已退款' WHEN ora.status = 'CANCELLED' THEN '已取消' ELSE '未知状态' END as status_description, ora.audit_remark, ora.audit_time, ora.refund_time, ora.created_time, ora.updated_time FROM order_refund_applies ora LEFT JOIN orders o ON ora.order_id = o.id WHERE ora.order_id = #{orderId} AND ora.is_deleted = 0 ORDER BY ora.created_time DESC

SELECT id, order_id, refund_no, refund_type, apply_amount AS refund_amount, apply_reason AS refund_reason, status, audit_remark, audit_time, refund_time, created_by, created_time, updated_by, updated_time, is_deleted, deleted_time FROM order_refund_applies WHERE refund_no = #{refundNo} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.update:
UPDATE order_refund_applies SET status = #{status},
audit_remark = #{auditRemark},
updated_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 0
mapper.select: SELECT o.store_id AS storeId, o.merchant_id AS merchantId, ora.refund_type AS refundType, COUNT(*) AS refundCount, SUM(ora.apply_amount) AS refundAmount, AVG(TIMESTAMPDIFF(HOUR, ora.created_time, ora.audit_time)) AS avgProcessHours FROM order_refund_applies ora INNER JOIN orders o ON ora.order_id = o.id WHERE DATE(ora.created_time) = #{statDate} AND ora.status = 'REFUNDED' AND ora.is_deleted = 0 GROUP BY o.store_id, o.merchant_id, ora.refund_type
